verses.mystical_translation: Betrayal narrows the world; trust opens it again.
The poem enters through ziphite superscription, betrayal, enemies, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when fear, power, memory, and relationship are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
